decision: Memory is a continuity layer, not an AIDY source of truth. Runtime/data/source repo evidence overrides Memory.
reason: Prevent stale AI context from becoming production truth.

decision: Keep AIDY formal-forward authority OFF unless explicitly graduated with evidence and owner approval.
reason: Research/decision infrastructure must not silently acquire real-money authority.

decision: Day 6 will implement bounded archive retry/backoff and explicit dead-letter handling, preserving capture independence and evidence truth.
reason: Day 5 made poison/backlog visible but intentionally avoided a pre-open schema/runtime mutation.

decision: Provider identity/style/behaviour history is owned and versioned append-only in Super Signals; AIDY remains the separate point-in-time market/context truth service.
reason: Provider knowledge must be reconstructable without duplicating provider state into AIDY or giving research broker authority.
source: Super Signals migration 0056_provider_profile_versions and live production verification

decision: Historical/forward provider research may use only an immutable provider profile version effective at or before the signal timestamp; unverifiable pre-Day-7 provider research remains legacy_unresolvable and cannot become PIT-clean score evidence.
reason: Prevent hindsight leakage from current/future provider knowledge into historical evaluation before joining provider setups to AIDY context.
source: Super Signals migration 0057_provider_pit_boundary; PR #141; production Postgres verification

decision: Treat AIDY formal-forward authority as WAITING - RUNTIME UNVERIFIED rather than asserting it is OFF. Do not state either value until the Cloudflare Worker variable AIDY_FORMAL_FORWARD_ENABLED and the D1 aidy_forward_restart_runs campaign row have been read.
reason: Memory asserted formal_forward_enabled false as settled, but phase-b-forward-restart.yml runs every ten minutes on main and is explicitly designed to redeploy the Worker with the flag set to true once its gate passes. Asserting a stale safety flag is worse than admitting the gap.

decision: Rewrite AIDY Memory from Day 10 point-in-time context service to the actual Architecture V2 master-trader system at Day 53 plus Hub Phase A and Phase B, and label the whole rewrite SOURCE VERIFIED rather than production verified.
reason: Memory described AIDY as a context endpoint while the source repository had already added a falsifiable Master Trader contract, k=3 self-consistency, an immutable decision ledger, a paper simulator, a management watcher, a Telegram publisher and permanent episode memory. A continuity layer that is forty-three build days behind actively misleads the next session.
source: dannythehat/Aidy-Gold-Signals main cb0f4bc; branch and docs survey 2026-09-14

decision: AIDY exposes the Data Hub feeds /provider/data-health (Phase A) and /provider/decision-memory (Phase B), bearer-authenticated on the same token as /market/ohlc and /provider/context, failing closed with HTTP 503. Consuming them is Super Signals work; AIDY's side of the Hub is delivered.
reason: Prevent the Hub build from rebuilding AIDY-side telemetry that already exists, and keep the one-way AIDY to Super Signals trust direction intact.
